title: Rossi House Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Rossi House is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 1976 EAST COUNTY ROAD HIGHWAY 30A*Please be advised that two other homeowners are currently building homes simultaneously on adjacent lots of the Rossi House. That third-party construction activity may, on certain days and at certain times, impact the peaceful enjoyment of the Rossi House. Accordingly, the owners of the Rossi House are currently offering a substantial reduction in the daily rental rate of this property to take into account this possible disruption. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection agent to confirm the reduced rental rate that will apply for your desired dates at 1-855-411-1557.An Architectural Icon on the Gulf in Seaside, FloridaThe Rossi House is a true architectural masterpiece and the only home in the United States designed by Aldo Rossi, the renowned Pritzker Prize–winning architect and leading figure of late 20th-century Neo-Rationalism. Located directly on the beachfront in Seaside, Florida, this historic residence was the final home Rossi designed before his passing in 1997. The property holds a unique place in Seaside’s story, having also been owned by founders Robert and Daryl Davis, and was not offered as a vacation rental until 2021.Prime Beachfront Location on Seaside’s West EndSituated on Seaside’s western edge, the Rossi House offers the rare combination of peaceful seclusion and walkable access to town. Lush tropical landscaping and a light-filled interior create a private oasis, while Seaside’s Central Square is just a five-minute walk away. Guests are also moments from the shops, dining, and galleries of nearby WaterColor, making this location ideal for experiencing the best of Scenic Highway 30A.A Grand Arrival and Thoughtful DesignFrom the moment you arrive, the Rossi House makes a lasting impression. Classical columns frame the entryway, crowned by a distinctive oculus window that reflects Rossi’s timeless design philosophy. Inside, a beautifully crafted staircase leads to the main living level, setting the tone for a home where every detail has been carefully considered and masterfully executed.Light-Filled Living Spaces with Gulf ViewsThe main living level opens to a spacious living room featuring a sofa, four club chairs, and a dining table for four—perfect for cocktails, conversation, or a quiet evening puzzle with stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico. Adjacent to this space, a second living area with a vaulted ceiling unites the kitchen, dining, and living areas into a serene Great Room. Floor-to-ceiling windows on the southern wall frame breathtaking views of the dunes and emerald waters beyond.Chef’s Kitchen and Elegant DiningThe wood-paneled kitchen is both elegant and functional, equipped with top-of-the-line Miele and Gaggenau appliances. A breakfast bar with seating for three provides a casual gathering space, while the adjacent dining area comfortably seats ten—ideal for shared meals and entertaining with a coastal backdrop.Private Terrace and Primary Suite RetreatCompleting the main living level is a private beachfront terrace, perfect for morning coffee or sunset cocktails overlooking Seaside’s private beach. Also on this floor, the oversized king primary suite features floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping Gulf views, a writing desk, seating area, and Smart TV. The spa-like primary bathroom showcases artfully crafted stone, abundant natural light, and a luxurious 13-jet steam shower.Guest Suites Designed for Comfort and PrivacyThe lower level of the home offers two beautifully appointed guest suites. One king bedroom features modern furnishings, an 80” Smart TV, and French doors opening to a private porch, along with a private bath accented by wave-patterned tile. The second guest room includes two queen beds, built-in storage, large dressers, a private Smart TV, and an en-suite bathroom. A full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located on this level.Experience Seaside, Florida at Rossi HouseBlending architectural significance, beachfront luxury, and an unparalleled Seaside location, the Rossi House offers a one-of-a-kind vacation experience on Florida’s Emerald Coast. This extraordinary home invites guests to immerse themselves in design, history, and the relaxed elegance of Seaside, Florida.* 5 night minimum in Spring & Spring Break, & Summer; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.* Some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance. SPECIAL NOTE: ACCESS TO THE ROOFTOP DECK IS NOT OFFERED TO GUESTS DUE TO LIABILITY CONSIDERATIONS.FEATURES2,750 square feet of indoor living space, complemented by generous outdoor living areasPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Natchez PavilionOne-minute walk (79 feet) to beach accessGourmet kitchen with state-of-the-art Miele and Gaggenau appliances, induction stovetopPeacock Alley Linens featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001933
